semiconductor_relevance: High — Maxell Taiwan Ltd provides specialized materials that support various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Maxell Taiwan Ltd specializes in providing advanced materials for semiconductor manufacturing, including dicing tapes for wafers and substrates, as well as back grinding tapes for bumped wafers. Their focus on unique Analog Core Technologies enables them to address customer challenges in miniaturization and refinement.
capabilities: Dicing tape for wafers and substrates
Back grinding tape for bumped wafers

regional_presence.Taiwan: Maxell Taiwan Ltd operates within Taiwan, focusing on semiconductor materials and solutions.
